root_causes: All-pairs mesh generation: BPs within a city fully-connected -> combinatorial route explosion (hub BPs at degree 40-42).
Land-crossing geometry rendered despite _qa_land_flag=true: 788 hand-waypoint pairs exist but were never fully applied at seal -> 202 land-cutting routes still visible.
Dirty BPs: bare city centroids ('Abu Dhabi','Fujairah','Ras Al Khaimah'), activity operators ('Jet Ski Abu Dhabi Waves','MSC','Boat ramp','DiveCampus'), planned/duplicate jetties.
West-coast (Gulf) and east-coast (Gulf of Oman / Fujairah) treated as one mesh -> routes cut across the Hajar mountains / Musandam.
Cross-border Qatar/Oman/Bahrain edges leak into the UAE view.
partner_divergence_cause: Routes carry NO commercial-partner tag (only _pta_partner + vessel platform). The front-end renders each partner's own _map_scope (registry_keys + cluster_city_ids + inheritance_policy). Bolt, Yango, Careem(mirror of Noon), and Noon each define a DIFFERENT UAE scope, so each filters the same messy 666-route pool differently -> four different-looking maps. Fix = one canonical UAE scope applied identically to all four.
target: Reduce ~666 rendered -> ~35-45 significant, clean, in-range, no-land-crossing corridors; ~60-80 real on-water BPs; ONE shared UAE _map_scope across careem/bolt/yango/noon.
